decision: Tour panoramique avec billetterie autonome sur la colline de Petřín ; le labyrinthe de miroirs et le funiculaire sont des équipements voisins, pas des éléments de cette fiche.

officialPricing.liftExtra: 150 adults / ages 6–26; 50 for 65+; exceptions for disability-card holders
officialPricing.earlyBird: 50% first hour except December 25 and January 1

officialHours: 10:00–18:00 daily October–December 2026, except 24 December 10:00–15:00, 25 December 11:00–18:00, 26 December 10:00–19:00, 31 December 10:00–16:00. The official page displays January 1 with year 2026, not extrapolated to 2027.
accessibility: 299 steps to the upper viewpoint. The lift carries wheelchair users only to the lower platform; the upper platform lacks wheelchair manoeuvring space. Under-15 visitors require an accompanying adult.
history: Built for the 1891 Jubilee Exhibition; publication event recorded with year precision.
photos: Three exact Commons photos visually inspected: exterior at dusk in 2013, entrance interior in 2014, tower among autumn trees in 2015. CC BY-SA 3.0/4.0; author, source, license and reduction noted. Eight localized alt texts, captions and credits.
